nodes.label: Windows x64 build and verification
nodes.rationale: Windows CI pins Python 3.14.7, .NET 10, tzdata and NSIS; clears provider credentials; runs Python/native-bridge tests, packaging and installation/window/shutdown/uninstall verification before uploading artifacts.

nodes.label: Tagged Windows release
nodes.rationale: Only nomisma-v tag pushes publish releases, after the build succeeds and downloaded package checksums pass. Ordinary builds produce Actions artifacts.
